description: The donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually compares the performance of three large language models—GPT-4o, GPT-4o (again, likely representing a different evaluation context or variant), and LLaMA—based on their respective win rates in a comparative evaluation. The chart consists of three colored segments: a large dark blue segment labeled “GPT-4o: 98.4%”, a slightly smaller medium blue segment labeled “GPT-4o: 96.8%”, and a small light blue segment labeled “LLaMA: 3.2%”. A gray legend box is present but unlabeled. The central white circle contains the chart’s title. The two GPT-4o segments dominate the chart, collectively accounting for 95.2% of the total, while LLaMA’s segment is visually minimal, reflecting its significantly lower win rate. The chart does not include percentage labels inside the slices, relying instead on external labels connected by lines. The segments appear ordered by size, with the largest segment positioned at the bottom right and the smallest at the top.
